# Profile Tool

- Source: [Profile Tool — RH Mods](https://rhmods.com/tools/profile-tool/)

- Language: English

## Description

A small tool where you can edit resolution and difficulty for your in-game profiles.

Profiles file is located in your `Data/Savegame` folder.
